{{Nihongo|'''Hideo Mōri'''|毛利秀雄|Mōri Hideo}} (also spelt as '''Hideo Mohri'''<ref name=":0" />; born 6 June 1930) is a Japanese biologist. He is best known for the discovery of [[tubulin]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=日本人名大辞典+Plus,世界大百科事典内言及 |first=デジタル版 |title=毛利秀雄(もうり ひでお)とは？ 意味や使い方 |url=https://kotobank.jp/word/%E6%AF%9B%E5%88%A9%E7%A7%80%E9%9B%84-1115110 |access-date=2024-06-15 |website=コトバンク |language=ja}}</ref>

== Life ==
He was born on 6 June 1930. He is the great-grandson of Duke [[Sadahiro Mōri]], the 28th head of the [[Mōri clan]]. He is also related to the [[Tokugawa clan]] through his grandmother Masako, who was a sister of Marquess [[Yoshichika Tokugawa]], the botanist. His maternal grandmother, Ariko, was the daughter of the founder of [[Shiseido]], [[Arinobu Fukuhara]], and through him, he is related to the Nobel laureate in Chemistry, [[Ryōji Noyori|Ryoji Noyori]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite book |last=Hideo |first=Mohri |title=The Pursuit of Biology |publisher=Minerva house |year=2010 |isbn=9784623057535}}</ref>

He graduated from the [[University of Tokyo]]'s [[Graduate School of Science and Faculty of Science, University of Tokyo|Faculty of Science]], Department of Zoology in 1953. His specialisation was in reproductive biology and animal physiological chemistry. He continued research on [[sperm]] at the graduate school of his alma mater and the university's [[Miura, Kanagawa|Misaki]] Marine Biological Centre from 1968 to 1990. He elucidated the constituent proteins of the sperm flagellum's structural body ([[cytoskeleton]]).<ref>{{Cite web |last=株式会社ローソンエンタテインメント |title=毛利秀雄｜プロフィール｜HMV&BOOKS online |url=https://www.hmv.co.jp/artist_%E6%AF%9B%E5%88%A9%E7%A7%80%E9%9B%84_000000000253893/biography/ |access-date=2024-06-15 |website=HMV&BOOKS online |language=ja}}</ref> In 1968, he determined the amino acid composition of the microtubule's constituent proteins and named it [[tubulin]].<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Mohri |first=H. |date=1968-03-16 |title=Amino-acid composition of "Tubulin" constituting microtubules of sperm flagella |journal=Nature |volume=217 |issue=5133 |pages=1053–1054 |doi=10.1038/2171053a0 |issn=0028-0836 |pmid=4296139}}</ref> From 1987 to 1989, he served as Dean of the [[College of Arts and Sciences, University of Tokyo|College of Arts and Sciences]]. In 1991, he retired from the University of Tokyo and was conferred the title of professor emeritus.
